title: Hero
name: hero
description: Content Fragment Model backing the EDS Hero block and all seven of its variants (base + 6 presets). Single shared model; variant-specific field locking/visibility is enforced in the Universal Editor component definitions, not in the model itself, because AEM Content Fragment Models cannot express per-consumer conditional requiredness.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.notes: Spec: 'Primary hero headline'. Required=n/a in spec (base) / N (all named variants) -> modeled as optional everywhere.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.notes: Spec: 'Supporting subheadline text'. Optional everywhere per spec.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.notes: Spec lists 'Image' twice with two field types ('Image URL' and 'Image URL DAM Picker'). Both rows are collapsed into ONE content-reference field resolved through the DAM asset picker; see Assumptions and Gaps, item A2.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alt
fields.notes: Spec: 'Image Alt text'. Required=N in spec, kept optional; runtime falls back to alt="" (decorative) when empty, per WCAG guidance -- see Accessibility section.

fields.name: actions
fields.label: Actions
fields.notes: Spec: 'Action Multifiled ... Max 2 first is primary and second is Static light', shown alongside separate flat 'Action Text'/'Action Link' fields. Modeled as the multifield (the more complete/superset definition); the flat fields are treated as legacy aliases -- see Assumptions and Gaps, item A3.

fields.name: height
fields.label: Height
fields.notes: Required=n/a on base 'Hero'; Required=Y on all six named variants, where the value is locked by the variant selection itself (see Assumptions and Gaps, item A1).

fields.name: textAlignment
fields.label: Text Alignment
fields.notes: Same required-locking pattern as Height (item A1).

fields.name: imagePosition
fields.label: Image Position
fields.notes: Required=Y and locked to 'center' on the two Tall variants; Required=N / value 'n/a' (field not applicable) on Standard and Compact variants; free-choice on base 'Hero'.
